get.description:
Return a list of active Projects.

If the authenticated user has full company admin permissions the request will return all of the projects in the company. If the user does not have full company admin permissions, the request will only return the projects that the user has been added to.
The default pagination is 100 projects per page. The max page size is 300 projects due to the size of the data in the response.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

post.description:
Create a new Project in a Procore account. The new project is active by default.

#### Country and State codes
The `country_code` and `state_code` parameter values must conform to the ISO-3166 Alpha-2 specification.
See [Working with Country Codes](/documentation/country-codes) for additional information.
#### Recommendation
For accounts creating a significant number of projects (more than 300),  schedule these operations during non-business hours (5 P.M PST - 7 A.M PST) to optimize efficiency. Coordinate the timing with your solution architect for insights into system load and effective resource utilization.

x-changelog.description:
The GET /projects/{id} and PATCH /projects/{id} endpoints now properly validate that the
company_id query parameter or Procore-Company-Id header (if provided) matches the project's
actual company. Previously, these parameters were ignored and projects could be retrieved or
updated using any company_id where the user had access. Now, if a company_id is specified
(via query parameter or header) that does not match the project's company, the API will
return a 404 Not Found response. When both query parameter and header are provided, the
query parameter takes precedence. This change improves API consistency and security by
ensuring the company_id parameter and header are respected as filters.

x-changelog.summary: Add portfolio_program_uuid to project create, update, bulk, and sync payloads
x-changelog.description: Project write payloads now accept optional `portfolio_program_uuid`, the public UUID of the Portfolio Program the Project is placed under (distinct from the legacy `program_id` grouping). Null means unassigned. When the company does not have Portfolio Programs, the parameter is ignored and the rest of the payload still saves. Invalid placements are rejected with reason codes `PLACEMENT_STALE`, `PLACEMENT_FORBIDDEN`, or `PROJECT_LOCKED`. Bulk create and sync fail the affected row rather than the whole request.

x-changelog.summary: Standardize manual coordinate actor fallback behavior
x-changelog.description: Project update flows that create manual latitude/longitude history now align with company-scoped actor formatting behavior in downstream change history responses, including fallback to Unknown when name resolution is unavailable.

x-changelog.summary: Capture coordinate and department updates in project change history
x-changelog.description: The project update endpoints now record Active History entries for manual latitude/longitude changes and department updates, ensuring these updates appear in project admin change history responses.

x-changelog.summary: Return proper validation error for invalid active param on project update
x-changelog.description: The PATCH /projects/{id} endpoint now returns a 400 Bad Request with a clear error message when the active parameter contains an invalid value (e.g., a random string). Previously, invalid values were silently accepted.

x-changelog.summary: Add field length validation for project_number
x-changelog.description:
Added validation to prevent StringDataRightTruncation errors when creating or updating
projects. The project_number field now has a maximum length of 255 characters.

When this field exceeds 255 characters, the API will now return a 422 Unprocessable Entity
response with a descriptive error message instead of a 500 Internal Server Error.

x-changelog.summary: Enforce company_id parameter and Procore-Company-Id header validation on GET and PATCH project endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The GET /projects/{id} and PATCH /projects/{id} endpoints now properly validate that the
company_id query parameter or Procore-Company-Id header (if provided) matches the project's
actual company. Previously, these parameters were ignored and projects could be retrieved or
updated using any company_id where the user had access. Now, if a company_id is specified
(via query parameter or header) that does not match the project's company, the API will
return a 404 Not Found response. When both query parameter and header are provided, the
query parameter takes precedence. This change improves API consistency and security by
ensuring the company_id parameter and header are respected as filters.
